crossRefs.note: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when…
Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

parallels.note: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will…

translations.web: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch.”
translations.bsb: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!”
translations.kjv: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
translations.asv: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
